The slope of the May-September key selling season converting the remaining US SHOP occupancy gap (still only 87% occupied portfolio-wide, 83% in the 25%-of-NOI non-same-store pool) into the guided ~300bps of occupancy growth - management named this variable themselves on the 2026Q2 call ("the slope and timing of the key selling season is the main determinant to the full year results, and we are in the middle of it right now"), and it is the one input that decides whether 16% SHOP same-store NOI holds or the whole 8-10% FFO algorithm resets.
